main_text.head: NICOLAO HARLÆO INTERIORIS CONSILII REGII Consiliario: Turmæ equitum præfecto: & militiæ Regię aduersus Sabaudię Ducem Legato.

p.i: HArlaæ duro tempore cui fides, Virtusque Francis cognita regibus Illustre per seras nepotum Progenies feret vsque nomen.
Me Musa cogit tendere barbiton Iani Calendis: queis remeans noua Phœbus renascentem fouere Purpureus face gestit annum.

Et læta festas Æolio iubet Tibi salutes dicere pectine: Te cura pro charis Geneua Solicitum licet inquieta Muris fatiget: dum procul improbos Nostris Sabaudi pellere finibus Tentas furores: & morantes Hic nimium remouere belli Causas furentis. Nil strepitus lyra

main_text.notes: The title and first lines are in mixed roman and italic; "HArlaæ" is the large initial H joined to ARLÆE. Last line is cut off at the foot of the page; no catchword or signature visible. The Greek-style ornament at the top is a woodcut, not text.
